misc: His usual shot shape could be described as a "power draw".
biography: Jussi occupies an engaging and dynamic position within the illustrious lineage of the Hector Trophée, bringing his formidable golfing skills from the lush fairways of St. Laurence Golf to the prestigious pair competition across five distinct editions. Characterized by a remarkably vibrant and expressive personality on the course, this dedicated gentleman approaches every round with an infectious enthusiasm that continually uplifts his companions.

Among his peers, Jussi is particularly renowned for possessing a breathtakingly majestic tee shot, with his usual ball flight affectionately categorized by observers as a textbook power draw that effortlessly cuts through gusting crosswinds. While the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual brilliance of the Victor Trophy have thus far eluded his grasp across his five tournament appearances, his ongoing participation in the vibrant community surrounding the event ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains wide open, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next brilliant masterclass.
